svg.title: From specimen to sequence: Huang MEGA Lab Nanopore workflow
svg.text: From specimen to sequence: Huang MEGA Lab Nanopore workflow
amplicon (two-step or one-pot PCR) or whole genome · scan or click a QR code to open the protocol · LIMS stages 1 → 2 → 3a → 3b → 4a
soil / environmental / insect | fungal strain in culture
primary plate on MEA (Stage 2a) → subculture one colony / hyphal tip on PDA
one Stage-2b row per isolate · preserve in vials
sequence from a pure culture only
Stage 2a plate → Stage 2b isolate → Culture# per strain
biofilm on the same inoculum: 72 h, then
MIC per drug, CV, MTT → Culture record
soil: SuperSoil, Zixpress 32 | fungal / HMW gDNA: BOMB v9
genome route: keep the DNA high-molecular-weight
environmental samples (soil, water) and mixed templates
2nd PCR products: one tube per sample, one barcode per tube
50 µL: KAPA HiFi 2X + both primer sets + 3 µL template
One-pot PCR products: one tube per sample, one barcode per tube
same barcoded molecule from either route
Stage 4a → Nanopore#: experiment + flow cell, add samples (PCR barcode) → pooling volumes
Route C · genome, no PCR (Stage 3a → 4a, no 3b)
Stage 4a → genome samples: MolWork# + NB barcode
Load the flow cell and sequence
run it on the run folder with the LIMS sample sheet
run it on the project directory
Stage 4a → flow cell: pores after wash, date of use
Head seq: universal tail on the gene-region primers
Barcode: sample-specific, on the barcode primers
QR code: scan, or click on the website, to open that step's protocol PDF
Left bands = LIMS stages; /lims-register ends every stage; dashed = QC / info
Strain phenotyping (MIC + biofilm): Stage 2 side branch → Culture record
Route C uses native barcodes (NBD114.96) in the library: no PCR, no Stage 3b
/nanoamp, /nanogenome: Claude Code analysis skills for the run data
